history.hint: Every change is saved automatically. Loading an old save stores it as a new save, and all images and later saves are kept.

delete.title: Delete this character?

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted characters stay here and can be restored. Once you delete one permanently, it can't be recovered.
